claim.text: ONS reported London resident employment rate of 73.9% and inactivity rate of 20.5% for ages 16 to 64, and unemployment of 6.8% for economically active residents aged 16 and over, for May-July 2026.
claim.headline: London employment 73.9%, unemployment 6.8%
